worldcombat.skill.flowershield.summary: Pushes a ring of petals out with a mysterious power, raising the Defense of every Grass-type Pokemon in radius; a foe's Grass types are shielded too, and the petals fall after a while.
worldcombat.skill.flowershield.use.0: Put Defense on a whole ring of Grass allies
worldcombat.skill.flowershield.use.1: Shield your own side while the foe's Grass types stand in the ring
worldcombat.skill.flowershield.use.2: Pad Defense before a wave of hits arrives
worldcombat.skill.flowershield.descripti: Pushes a petal wave of radius %1$s blocks from the user, lasting %2$s.
Grass types in the ring gain %1$s stage of Defense, about %2$s petals per wave; friend and foe alike.
worldcombat.skill.flowershield.dense.on: Dense: +1 Defense, x1.25 duration, more petals, but the wave is x0.72 wide, +2 ticks telegraph, x1.12 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.flowershield.dense.off: Scattered: a x1.25 wider wave, cheaper telegraph and cooldown, but base Defense and a shorter window.
worldcombat.skill.flowershield.timing: Self move, covering a %1$s block radius; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.flowershield.growth.0: From level %1$s: petals last %2$s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.flowershield.growth.1: From level %1$s: petals last %2$s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.flowershield.preferenc: Dense: +1 Defense, x1.25 duration, more petals, but the wave is x0.72 wide, +2 ticks telegraph, x1.12 cooldown - shield a few targets. Scattered: a x1.25 wider wave, cheaper telegraph and cooldown, base Defense and a shorter window - cover a ring.
Consider the petal wave only while a threat is this close; larger starts earlier.
How wide the move's own ring counts; larger reaches for further Grass allies.
